title: I'm building an AI tool to help traders find their edge
author: Icecoldobsidian
selftext:
Every trader has his trading strategy and believes that he knows what works and what does not. But how much does the trader actually know about his strategy based on his own trading data?

I am creating a Chartix trading journal to help you objectively analyze your trading and find out what exactly works and does not work for you.

Chartix will help you avoid tracking and analyzing your trades on your own by providing you with different trading performance statistics depending on the instrument, direction of the trade, weekdays, and so on,

find profitable setups and patterns for you, help you find the reasons for your losses and analyze which trades and patterns are the most losing 

Chartix can also help you collect charts and track your trades by allowing you to turn your chart images into journal entries and, finally, analyze the last trades using artificial intelligence to find profitable patterns.

Chartix, is still being developed and I would love to hear some feedback regarding this idea.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the split by setup is where a journal earns its keep. the catch is sample size, most people log maybe 20 trades per setup in a quarter, and at 20 a good setup and a bad one look about the same.
